name: tap the egg
desc:
THANK YOU FOR 150,000 VISITS! NEW UPDATE COMING SOON.

THIS GAME IS A WORK IN PROGRESS. IF YOU HAVE ANY SUGGESTIONS OR WANT TO REPORT BUGS, PLEASE VISIT THE GROUP PAGE. THANK YOU

how to play egg
tap egg
buy upgrade
buy pet
get a lot of tap
rebirth to multiply many tap
sell egg for yolkcoin or robuck**
done

*Note: To tap offline you must purchase the Auto Tapper Gamepass. Additionally, some gamepasses may require you to rejoin to work!

**Robux purchases for eggs are made in-game. Create a dev product for your egg to list it for robux. Go to https://create.roblox.com/dashboard/creations , and click on an experience. Scroll down to the monetization section and click on "Developer Products." Set the product to the price you want to sell the item for and enter the id of the product in settings.
This allows players to donate to you for your eggs! If you are buying with robux, you must leave and rejoin to see your newly acquired egg.
